newsitem.title: USA: Seven die in Wisconsin traffic accident.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in Wisconsin traffic accident.

text.p: Seven people were killed when the van in which they were riding was crushed between two trucks on a snow-slick highway on Wednesday, police said.
The Washington County Sheriff's office said an eighth person in the van survived but was in critical condition and three other people were less seriously hurt.

A spokeswoman for the sheriff's office said the accident happened at dawn when a northbound trailer truck lost control and crossed the median, striking a southbound truck which then crossed back into the northbound lanes, pinning a van carrying nine people between it and a third truck.
Roads were slick from an overnight snowfall although it was not snowing at the time of the accident on state highway 41 near this village about 40 miles northwest of Milwaukee.
The identities of the victims were not immediately available.
